title: 第5章 你竟然擅闯苏师姐房间
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
陈默正打算动身的时候，刚走了没几步系统面板上面就出现了一个提示立刻浮现在眼前。

    只见上面显示着。

    【宿主真是卑鄙至极，竟然打算前往内门师姐苏婉清的房间意图不轨。】

    【任务要求：在师姐房间内犯下恶事。】

    【任务完成后可获得隐匿符奖励，可在一个时辰内获得隐匿的法术效果】

    陈默忍不住地笑了起来。

    当下也是激动不已。

    这系统主打的就是一个左右脑互博，左脑攻击右脑，一方面谴责自己说自己意图不轨，另一方面又奖励自己隐匿符。

    陈默在心中喃喃自语道。

    他快步走着，来到内门区域的时候立刻便使用隐匿符没有引起任何的人察觉。

    直接大踏步地进门去了。

    不一会的功夫，他就来到一个厢房这就是苏婉清的房间了。

    门口的几个侍女来来回回进出。

    陈默推开门走进了这闺房当中，刚一进门就闻到一股香味。

    在整个房间当中弥漫着。

    “这应该就是苏婉清师姐的房间了，根据系统的提示一个时辰之后，这里将会降下福泽有几率提升实力？”

    陈默在心中说道。

    于是便找个地方坐了下来在这里静等。

    不过说起师姐苏婉清，可以说是整个宗门数一数二的天骄之女了，比起她师姐林凤瑶来说压根没有任何相提并论的资格。

    “如果待会儿获得这天降的福泽机缘，不知道能让我的修为势力提升到什么样的境界和等级？”

    待在房间里的陈默心中也是充满了好奇，已经有些迫不及待了起来，他坐在苏婉清的榻上静静地等待了起来眼神中也有几分跃跃欲试。

    ……

    而同一时间，陆瑶带着一肚子的火气带着林凤瑶来到了陈默的住处。

    刚刚来到了门口就冲着里面喊着说道。

    “陈默你这个混帐！抢了我的灵石还不赶紧滚出来！”

    “我告诉你陈默，你躲在里面不出来当缩头乌龟也没用，我已经带师姐过来替我主持公道了你躲在里面也没用。”

    “陈默我警告你，你要是不想把事情搞的太难看的话就乖乖给我滚出来，不然的话我就把你住的这破地方一把火烧了。”

    站在门口的陆瑶怒吼道。
content_en:
When Chen Mo was about to leave, a prompt appeared on the system panel after he had taken a few steps.

    I saw it displayed above.

    [The host is so despicable that he actually plans to go to the room of the inner sect sister Su Wanqing with evil intentions. 】

    [Task requirement: Commit evil deeds in senior sister’s room. 】

    [After completing the task, you can get the concealment symbol as a reward, and you can obtain the concealment spell effect within an hour]

    Chen Mo couldn't help laughing.

    I was very excited at the moment.

    The main feature of this system is a cross-brain exchange between the left and right brains. The left brain attacks the right brain. On the one hand, it condemns itself and says that its intentions are evil, and on the other hand, it rewards itself with concealment charms.

    Chen Mo murmured to himself.

    He walked quickly, and when he arrived at the inner door area, he immediately used the concealment charm without causing anyone to notice.

    He strode directly through the door.

    After a while, he came to a side room, which was Su Wanqing's room.

    Several maids at the door came and went.

    Chen Mo opened the door and walked into the boudoir. As soon as he entered, he smelled a scent.

    It permeated the whole room.

    "This should be Senior Sister Su Wanqing's room. According to the system prompts, after an hour, there will be blessings here, and there is a chance that the strength will increase?"

    Chen Mo said in his heart.

    So I found a place to sit down and wait here.

    However, when it comes to senior sister Su Wanqing, she can be said to be one of the most talented daughters in the entire sect. Compared to her senior sister Lin Fengyao, she has no qualifications to be compared to her.

    "If I get this blessing opportunity from heaven later, I wonder what realm and level my cultivation power can be raised to?"

    Chen Mo, who was staying in the room, was full of curiosity and couldn't wait. He sat on Su Wanqing's couch and waited quietly, with a bit of eagerness in his eyes.

    …

    At the same time, Lu Yao brought Lin Fengyao to Chen Mo's residence with a lot of anger.

    As soon as he reached the door, he shouted inside.

    "Chen Mo, you bastard! Get out of here if you haven't snatched my spirit stone!"

    "I'm telling you Chen Mo, it's useless for you to hide in there and be a coward. I've already brought my senior sister here to seek justice for me. It's useless for you to hide in there."

    "Chen Mo, I'm warning you, if you don't want to make things too ugly, just get out of here, otherwise I will burn down this miserable place where you live."

    Lu Yao, who was standing at the door, roared angrily.
title_en: Chapter 5 You actually broke into Senior Sister Su’s room without permission
